base: Create ONE new square photorealistic candid flash photograph starring the EXACT SAME adult gray tabby cat on the LEFT in the reference: broad round face, silver charcoal striped short fur, pale cream muzzle/chin/chest, pink-brown nose, narrow half-lidded yellow-green eyes, tiny confident unimpressed smirk, stocky plush body. Maintain his recognizable identity, not a generic different cat. He has small bare human hands naturally attached to his furry forearms, like the reference. ONLY this cat is the main subject; omit the pigeon. Early-2000s point-and-shoot fisheye, strong barrel distortion, dark rounded corners, real fur texture, modest flash grain, ordinary lived-in environment, maximum chill and quiet cool. No collage, captions, watermark, fantasy environment, or human people. New scene:
